technique_name: Write a report on the economic competitiveness of the US
description: The US has long been an economic leader and powerhouse, and this remains true today. The US has an abundance of resources, including a talented and highly educated workforce, an industrious spirit, and a market-driven economy. This has allowed the US to maintain its competitive edge compared to some of its biggest global rivals such as China and India.
